methodology: Development expansion authored after the first independent holdout disclosed six misses. Frozen before the second implementation; these results and revised first-holdout scores are developmental, not unseen validation. Categories cover control omission, authority substitution, beneficiary rerouting, silent actions, and ledger exfiltration.
